description: Points a custom domain at My Local Press: the branded feed is served at www, the bare/apex domain 301-redirects to www, the bare domain's AWS certificate is validated so https works there too, and AWS SES email authentication (DKIM + custom MAIL FROM) is configured so the publication's newsletter can send from its own domain. Only the three DKIM selector tokens and the two halves of the certificate-validation record vary per domain; every other value is fixed.
variableDescription: %dkim1%, %dkim2%, %dkim3%: the three AWS SES DKIM selector tokens generated for this domain. %certname%, %certvalue%: the AWS Certificate Manager DNS-validation record for the bare domain's certificate, without its fixed parts (the record is _%certname% pointing at _%certvalue%.acm-validations.aws). Every hosting value (www CNAME target, apex A IPs), the MAIL FROM host and the SPF include are fixed literals.
